sections.title: Player text
sections.body: As you land the blow that drops the last threat, the ritual ends. The carriage crashes back to earth and the Keystone blazes with arcane light. Then a soundless explosion erupts from the Custodian, washing outward, dissolving any enemy still standing. The screeching stops. The clawing stops. The clearing is quiet again, the open sky calm above you. It is done. The ward is renewed. You held the line, and a city you may never see will wake tomorrow still safe.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Finish the ritual; the ward is renewed.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Resolve countdown zero, clear the field, and set ritual_outcome and custodian_fate.

sections.title: GM notes
items: If custodian_fate=dying, mark it as a canon-sensitive result until Kyle rules whether she can die.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "Clock at zero. Fight over. The blast clears whatever remains. You do not have to mop up. Breathe, then we count what it cost."
